hits.text: **Current progress: eight of ten substantial findings accepted.** [R014](frontier/findings/R014-uniform-coefficient-extraction.md) is the newest accepted finding. [I80](frontier/iterations/i80-geometric-flows-computation-discovery.md) proposes compact velocity, pressure and solenoidal rapid forcing for fluid computation. [I85](frontier/reviews/i85-compact-solenoidal-computation-r2.md) passes its original proof without repairs, and parent evidence reproduction passes. [I86](frontier/reviews/i86-compact-solenoidal-computation-novelty-r3.md) completes the relevant-companion comparison and classifies C80 as **technical**, via a complete moving compact-Euler-template reduction. The original proof PASS is retained; no finding is added. Its frozen verifier’s inventory-sorting failure and successful read-only correction are both preserved. [I83](frontier/iterations/i83-catalan-finite-measure.md) passes the original I81 technical proofs without repairs, but leaves Catalan’s finite irrationality exponent unproved and unrefuted after two developed routes; parent evidence reproduction passes and that branch is parked. [I84](frontier/iterations/i84-abstract-close-algebras.md) proves abstract nonisomorphism for the actual close-algebra examples. [I87](frontier/reviews/i87-abstract-close-algebras-r2.md) passes the original proof without repairs and confirms its technical disposition; parent evidence reproduction passes. [I88](frontier/iterations/i88-nonlinear-banach-discovery.md) gives technical support-size and qualitative rank bounds, but leaves the quantitative rank target open; parent evidence checks pass. [I90](frontier/iterations/i90-anchored-rank-approximation.md) passes the original I88 proofs without repairs and proposes an exponential rank bound through weighted pairwise continuation and clipped discrepancy transfer. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I92](frontier/reviews/i92-anchored-rank-approximation-r2.md) passes the original Q90 proof and all stated variants without repairs; parent evidence reproduction passes. [I93](frontier/reviews/i93-anchored-rank-approximation-novelty-r3.md) classifies Q90 as technical through a complete source-operation/Auerbach/TV reduction; parent evidence reproduction passes. The original proof pass is retained without a count increment. [I94](frontier/iterations/i94-topology-transformation-discovery.md) gives author-level technical nonextension and even-stabilization threshold deductions; parent evidence reproduction passes. Its sharp relative involution target on V#2(S²×S²) remains unproved and unrefuted. [I97](frontier/iterations/i97-relative-involution-stabilization.md) passes original A/B without repairs and adds author-level technical restrictions on the residual product geometry and an exact cut-defect budget; parent evidence replay passes. R94 remains unproved and unrefuted. [I100](frontier/iterations/i100-defect-tolerant-topology-obstruction.md) passes original C/D/E and the scoped complement/Whitney claims without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its new technical residual presentation and periodic localization do not improve the stabilization bound, and an exact algebraic counterexample blocks rank-only tensor extensions. R94 remains unproved and unrefuted; the branch is parked pending new geometric control. [I103](frontier/iterations/i103-algebraic-complexity-discovery.md) gives complete author-level positive-characteristic rational hitting lists and an every-field 9/4 matrix-multiplication exponent transfer, both classified technical by its concrete source-operation comparison. [I106](frontier/iterations/i106-positive-characteristic-imm.md) passes all original constructions and scoped counterexamples without repairs and independently confirms the technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. [I109](frontier/iterations/i109-modular-imm-rank.md) passes all original I106 partials and scoped obstructions without repairs and confirms their technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. Its compatible periodic minors and exact excursion-rank decomposition remain too small for the circuit target. The full excursion degeneration has exponentially deficient rank in characteristic two; this is not an upper bound on full IMM rank. The all-prime target remains unproved and unrefuted, and this construction branch is parked. [I112](frontier/iterations/i112-inverse-boundary-discovery.md) gives author-level technical cap-transfer, physical-jet lifting and local rigidity results, plus a known-collar uniqueness reduction and scoped gauge/boundary-cost obstructions. Parent evidence replay passes. Arbitrary same-patch recovery of both Lamé coefficients remains unproved/unrefuted; the physical augmented jet space has dimension 32 versus 36 for unrestricted system jets. [I115](frontier/iterations/i115-physical-elasticity-continuation.md) preserves two original failures: G112 standalone invertibility needs boundary on every component, and R112 equal-coefficient normalization fails when the equal coefficient is λ=0. The surviving scoped claims pass. New cap construction, fourth-order physical moment closure and conditional comparison rigidity remain author-level technical results. Parent evidence and an independently rebuilt 165×165 determinant certificate pass. [I118](frontier/iterations/i118-physical-quotient-angular.md) passes original I115 at its stated scopes without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its new author-level technical results give a sharp physical quotient norm criterion, a local evaluation representative and conditional frontier continuation. The nonnormal physical boundary symbol and an uncontrolled trace-kernel component prevent importing the scalar estimate. [I121](frontier/iterations/i121-physical-transfer-bound.md) passes original I118 without repairs at its stated scopes; parent evidence replay passes. New author-level technical work gives frozen accretivity, exact quotient coordinates and the physical boundary Cauchy-defect formula. Neither developed attempt bounds the actual continued flux uniformly. P112 remains unproved/unrefuted; both physical-transfer and expanding-Runge branches are parked pending a new mechanism. [I124](frontier/iterations/iteration124-fractal-incidence-discovery-task.json) audits these partials, then begins fresh fractal-incidence discovery. [I91](frontier/iterations/i91-finite-cat0-obstruction.md) passes the used I89 contraction prerequisites without repairs and proposes explicit finite CAT(0) contraction constants via fixed-scale geometry and a 29-point rational certificate. Parent evidence and exact certificate replay pass. [I95](frontier/reviews/i95-finite-cat0-obstruction-r2.md) passes the original Q91 proof and action-to-certificate implication without repairs; parent evidence and independent reconstruction pass. [I96](frontier/reviews/i96-finite-cat0-obstruction-novelty-r3.md) classifies the full Q91 theorem as technical through a complete source-operation reduction and a 12-point scalar contradiction; parent evidence replay passes and I95 resolves its proof condition. [I98](frontier/iterations/i98-complex-kahler-discovery.md) records author-level technical finite-radius and relative complete-spray constructions, with parent evidence replay passing. The arbitrary K3-family Oka-map target remains unproved and unrefuted; [I102](frontier/iterations/i102-relative-k3-oka-construction.md) passes original A98/W98 and both method obstructions without repairs, at the precise reduced-space interpolation scope. Parent evidence replay passes. Its compatible whole-central-slice germ, conditional relative sewing and adaptive exhaustion criterion remain technical; the fixed-domain extension is missing and R98 is parked unproved and unrefuted. [I104](frontier/iterations/i104-modular-representation-discovery.md) gives author-level technical equivariant subsection/trace identities, an all-length A5 divisibility estimate, and explicit obstructions to forgetting Frobenius descent data. Parent evidence replay passes; the blockwise Galois Alperin weight target remains unproved and unrefuted. [I108](frontier/iterations/i108-galois-tuple-divisibility.md) passes all original I104 claims without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. [I110](frontier/iterations/i110-galois-moment-cancellation.md) passes the original finite-moment criterion and constrained-puncture/index claims without repairs; parent replay passes. New exact fixed-label reconstruction, 56 finite moment certificates, a uniform A5×A divisibility bound for odd-order abelian A, and equivariant nontrivial local-point pairing are technical partials. Arbitrary admissible cancellation and G104 remain unproved/unrefuted; the trivial local-point component is unpaid and the branch is parked. [I114](frontier/iterations/i114-quantum-information-discovery.md) gives author-level technical thermal-balance trace-distance estimates and an energy-controlled logarithmic information-loss bound. Parent evidence replay passes. Unequal-temperature constrained entropy power stability remains unproved and unrefuted: the direct entropy-to-balance step is not established there, and the linear-qEPI deficit is positive even at its thermal optimizer. [I117](frontier/iterations/i117-bosonic-entropy-stability.md) passes original I114 at its stated scopes without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. New author-level technical work proves same-input deficit transfer and finite-energy optimizer uniqueness. Exact-constraint rare tails disprove both weighted and ordinary deficit-to-balance moduli and exclude power exponents above 1/2. [I120](frontier/iterations/i120-thermal-trace-stability.md) passes all original I117 analytic claims without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its new author-level technical theorem gives an explicit double-logarithmic trace-distance bound on the original finite-energy constraint set. A direct entropy-growth remainder and a fully constrained displaced-tail test leave every possible power exponent at most 1/2 unresolved. [I123](frontier/iterations/iteration123-thermal-production-stability-task.json) audits these proofs and pursues the trace-coercive remainder; Target B remains unproved/unrefuted. [I99](frontier/iterations/i99-quantitative-arithmetic-patterns-discovery.md) gives author-level joint-kernel estimates, sharp transfer obstructions and a coefficient-explicit counting bridge; parent evidence replay passes. Its uniform nonlinear Roth target remains unproved and unrefuted. [I101](frontier/iterations/i101-two-scale-nonlinear-roth.md) passes original A1–A5/B1–B4 and the scoped counterexamples without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its short-window graph bounds, actual parabolic matrix comparison and block-conditioned counts remain technical. C99 is parked unproved and unrefuted pending the precise deterministic block comparison (U). [I107](frontier/iterations/i107-rational-tail-attachment.md) passes all original [I105](frontier/iterations/i105-chromatic-homotopy-discovery.md) claims without repairs and supplies an author-level full proof of R105: the actual rational tail splits under F4 and over V for every p≥5 and allowed choice, retaining the nonzero middle attachment. Parent evidence replay passes. [I111](frontier/reviews/i111-rational-tail-attachment-r2.md) passes every component of the original full proof without repairs, including the uniform limit, actual detector injection and under/over compatibility, and independently confirms its technical disposition. Parent evidence replay passes; R105 is technically closed under the stipulated premises and no finding is added. [I113](frontier/iterations/i113-online-optimization-discovery.md) gives an author-level technical one-sample matroid-prophet guarantee of 2⁻²⁹⁵K⁻²⁷ under two-sided likelihood-ratio misspecification, one-sided impossibility examples, and exact stochastic Blackwell policy extraction. Parent evidence replay passes. [I116](frontier/iterations/i116-robust-prophet-continuation.md) passes every original I113 component without repairs and confirms its technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. Its new 1/(2K) local-filter bound concerns offline optimum, while its conditional and thinning counterexamples block specific methods. [I119](frontier/iterations/i119-one-loss-online-selection.md) passes original I116 without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. New author-level technical results sharpen offline filtering to 1/(K+1) and prove an online 1/[α(K+1)] guarantee for bounded positive weight spread. Weighted safe-rank accounting still leaves an aggregate pivotal and scale-allocation gap. The general c/K online target remains unproved/unrefuted and both arbitrary-weight routes are parked. [I122](frontier/iterations/i122-variational-free-boundary-discovery.md) passes original I119 without repairs, including the weighted chain; parent evidence replay passes. Its fresh Dini-coefficient singular-packing target remains unproved. Local radial-defect and conditional covariance estimates, an exact coordinate-change subclass and scoped examples are author-level technical results; the local monotonicity mechanism is already in current literature. [I125](frontier/iterations/iteration125-dini-singular-packing-task.json) audits these claims and pursues the missing uniform regularity and packing argument. Two further substantial findings are needed.

The clean proof uses rejection absorption and a weaker spectral interface with a log-determinant replacement for full rigidity. The [arbitrary-rank topology construction](iterations/i07-structures.md) retains its proof PASS but is **technical only** after [final significance review](reviews/i07-structures-novelty-r3.md): cyclic-cover reduction and replication over all binary directions supply the main rank conclusion. Parent diagnostics and the artifact seal reproduce. It does not increment the substantial-finding count.

- **Algebraic geometry:** the [K3 audit](reviews/geometry-k3-review-r2.md) accepts the corrected arithmetic comparison but gives a CM counterexample to its interpretation as the full known Hodge region; Lemma C is Varesco 2023. The [Mumford audit](reviews/geometry-mumford-review-r2.md) validates a repaired reduction but finds exact prior art. Neither establishes new substantive Hodge progress. The parent reproduced both independent audits and source hashes. The [construction round](reviews/geometry-mumford-bridge-r2.md) found no cycles. It proposes a split-sixfold partner and a conditional linking-class reduction; the [final audit](reviews/geometry-partner-review-r3.md) accepts a repaired classical construction and conditional reduction, with novelty unverified. The algebraic link remains unconstructed. No major new theorem is claimed.

The independent [parent probability/quantum screen](iterations/i07-parent-probability-screen.md) rejects two already-covered targets and a false quantum-memory extension. It derives a weighted necessary capacity condition for variable-edge four-state reconstruction and an exact counterexample to the naive unweighted extension. Iteration 08 now supplies a proposed converse, described below; the completed reviews now support R009 below.

The [geometric-analysis report](iterations/i07-analysis.md) is integrated as a negative/reduction checkpoint. The restricted inverse W¹,¹ transfer is routine; a smooth compression example blocks automatic higher inverse-energy control. General cut-locus separation and the required energy-controlled approximation remain unproved. Parent verification passes for 60 pinned sources, six literature retrievals and 81 author artifacts. No accepted-count increment is assigned.

The [arithmetic report](iterations/i07-arithmetic.md) is integrated with 38 verified pinned sources and 62 verified artifacts.
